description: Route templates the Fastly reference adapter routes to the DropShield backend. Test-time consistency check against contracts/origin-assertion-v1.json and DropShield.Api's TrafficRouteClassifier — not read by VCL at runtime.
notes: POST /graphql is routed to DropShield unconditionally: Fastly VCL cannot distinguish a protected addProductsToCart mutation from ordinary GraphQL traffic on the same shared endpoint, so DropShield.Api's GraphQlCartMutationInspector makes that decision after routing, not the edge.
The cart/checkout/graphqlCartAdd/storefrontCartAdd subset of dropshieldRoutes must stay byte-identical to the route templates in contracts/origin-assertion-v1.json.
GET /health is routed to DropShield so edge health checks reach the same instance origin traffic does; it is not a protected-mutation route and carries no origin assertion.
